svg.title: Verifying entry 31,337 with four tiles
svg.desc: The client verifies the checkpoint, then authenticates the right-edge tiles 2/000.p/1, 1/001.p/17 and 0/273.p/112 by rebuilding the root from them. For entry 31,337 it fetches level 0 tile 122, which gives 8 proof hashes inside that tile, and level 1 tile 0, which gives 8 more and also authenticates tile 122: tile 122 must hash to hash 122 of tile 1/000. The last proof hash, the right part of the tree, comes from the right-edge tiles. 17 hashes, 4 tiles beyond the edge.

text.tspan: the entry itself must hash to leaf 31,337 in 0/122
17 proof hashes, computed by the client; the server only stores files.
